title: Use Rsbuild as the frontend build tool

steps.task: Replace Vite with Rsbuild: point the package.json scripts at rsbuild, swap the devDependency, and add rsbuild.config.ts. The scaffold keeps its entry in `src/main.ts` and its own `index.html`, so tell Rsbuild about both — and let it inject the bundle script instead of the hardcoded Vite tags.

Point Tauri at the Rsbuild dev server and hooks: `pnpm dev` / `pnpm build` as the before-commands, Rsbuild's default port 3000 as `devUrl`, and `../dist` as `frontendDist`. The app's IPC must keep working with the new configuration.
